scope: Only paths already in original repo inventory with unresolved metadata; no repository writes, fetch, scripts, hooks or filesystem-wide scan
limitations: Ahead/behind uses existing local references, not current remote state.
Detached HEAD and absent upstream are explicit valid states, not access denials.
Original inventory preserved; no raw filenames or commit messages included.
